The '''Great Crystal of Aantonaii''' was an [[Dark side artifact/Legends|artifact]] of grave importance to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].

==History==
A massive, pulsating red [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]], the Great Crystal of Aantonaii was recovered by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] sometime during his life and would come to be kept in the [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center|Chancellor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center]] until the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Preserved within the facility's central chamber, the crystal was kept hidden from all of the [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter's]] staff.<ref name="SWCL" />
